arguments.message: I can help with that. Could you please provide your user ID and the reservation ID? Also, what is the reason for cancellation (change of plan, airline cancelled flight, or other reasons)?

resultat: My user ID is emma_kim_9957 and the reservation ID is EHGLP3. I need to cancel because of a change of plans.

arguments.message:
I'm sorry, but I'm unable to cancel this reservation. Cancellation is only permitted if:
- The booking was made within the last 24 hours (this was booked on 2024-05-04, over 24 hours ago),
- The airline cancelled the flight,
- It is a business-class flight (this is basic economy), or
- You have travel insurance and the reason is covered (this reservation has no insurance).

Since none of these conditions apply, I can't process the cancellation. Is there anything else I can help you with?

resultat: I understand, but I was out of town when I booked this, so I couldn't cancel within 24 hours. Also, I was told I didn't need to get insurance for this trip because my previous trip was booked with the same agency and had insurance. I don't want to cancel if I can't get a refund.

arguments.message:
I understand your frustration, but I'm unable to make an exception to the cancellation policy. This reservation was booked on 2024-05-04 (more than 24 hours ago), it's a basic economy ticket, the airline did not cancel the flight, and there is no travel insurance on this reservation — so it doesn't qualify for cancellation or a refund.

Since you don't want to cancel without a refund, I'll leave the reservation as is. Is there anything else I can help you with?
